parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: Reading a chart

options.label: First, read the title. It tells us what the chart is about.
Then, count. In this pictogram, each little book stands for one book.

steps.explanation: Read the title first, then the labels, then count.
steps.shortExplanation: Read the title first, then the labels, then count.

steps.title: The most books
steps.prompt: On which day did Seif read the most books?
steps.hint: Find the longest row of books.
steps.explanation: Tuesday has the longest row: 4 books, the most.
steps.shortExplanation: Tuesday has the longest row: 4 books, the most.

steps.title: Wednesday
steps.prompt: How many books did Seif read on Wednesday?
steps.hint: Touch and count each book in the Wed row.
steps.explanation: The Wed row has one book, so he read 1 book.
steps.shortExplanation: The Wed row has one book, so he read 1 book.

steps.title: Altogether
steps.prompt: How many books did Seif read altogether?
steps.hint: Count every book in every row: 2, 4, 1 and 3.
steps.explanation: Two and four and one and three make ten books altogether.
steps.shortExplanation: Two and four and one and three make ten books altogether.

steps.title: How many more?
steps.prompt: How many more books did Seif read on Tuesday than on Monday?
steps.hint: Tuesday has 4 and Monday has 2. How many extra?
steps.explanation: Tuesday has 4 and Monday has 2. Four is two more than two.
steps.shortExplanation: Tuesday has 4 and Monday has 2. Four is two more than two.

steps.title: The tallest bar
steps.prompt: Which rhyme family has the most words?
steps.explanation: The -at bar is the tallest: 5 words, the most.
steps.shortExplanation: The -at bar is the tallest: 5 words, the most.

steps.title: The -ee bar
steps.prompt: How many -ee words did we find?
steps.hint: Run a finger from the top of the -ee bar to the numbers.
steps.explanation: The -ee bar reaches 4, so we found 4 words.
steps.shortExplanation: The -ee bar reaches 4, so we found 4 words.

steps.title: The shortest bar
steps.prompt: Which rhyme family has the fewest words?
steps.explanation: The -og bar is the shortest: 2 words, the fewest.
steps.shortExplanation: The -og bar is the shortest: 2 words, the fewest.

steps.title: An -at word
steps.prompt: Write a word from the -at family: c…
steps.hint: It is a pet that says miaow.
steps.explanation: Cat ends with at, so it belongs to the -at family.
steps.shortExplanation: Cat ends with at, so it belongs to the -at family.

source.answerKeyText: Any -at word: cat, hat, mat, bat, sat, rat

stickers.meaning: A quick way to show information with pictures or bars.

goalActivities.text: Make a pictogram of the fruit in your kitchen. Ask: which fruit is there most of?
goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا رسم بالصور للفاكهة اللي في المطبخ، واسألوا: أنهي فاكهة عندنا منها أكتر؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Point to one row of a pictogram and your child touches and counts each picture.
goalActivities.textAr: شاور على صف في الرسم بالصور، وطفلك يلمس ويعدّ كل صورة.

goalActivities.text: Add up a whole pictogram together, one row at a time, with beans or buttons to help.
goalActivities.textAr: اجمعوا الرسم بالصور كله مع بعض، صف صف، واستعملوا فول أو زراير يساعدوكم.

goalActivities.text: Line up two rows of spoons, 4 and 2. Your child finds how many more are in the longer row.
goalActivities.textAr: رصّوا صفين معالق، أربعة واتنين، وطفلك يلاقي الصف الطويل فيه كام زيادة.

goalActivities.text: Play rhyme families: write -at on paper and find as many words as you can: cat, hat, mat, bat.
goalActivities.textAr: العبوا عيلة القوافي: اكتبوا -at على ورقة ولاقوا أكتر كلمات تقدروا عليها: cat و hat و mat و bat.

goalActivities.text: Draw a bar chart of your family's favourite colours together, then read one bar with your finger.
goalActivities.textAr: ارسموا رسم بالأعمدة للألوان المفضلة عند العيلة مع بعض، وبعدين اقروا عمود بصباعكم.

goalActivities.text: Look at a chart together and ask two questions: which is the most? Which is the fewest?
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا على رسم بياني مع بعض واسألوا سؤالين: أنهي الأكتر؟ وأنهي الأقل؟

goalActivities.text: Write -at on a card and change the first letter with your child: cat, hat, mat, bat, rat.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتبوا -at على كارت وغيّروا أول حرف مع طفلك: cat و hat و mat و bat و rat.

homeActivities.text: Keep a reading log together for a week and turn it into a pictogram: one little book drawn for each book read.
homeActivities.textAr: اعملوا سجل قراية مع بعض لمدة أسبوع، وحوّلوه لرسم بالصور: كتاب صغير مرسوم لكل كتاب اتقرا.
